name: MonarchAiVoiceMode
title: AiVoiceMode
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with an androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas visual, a verticalScroll captions log and MonarchButton controls (androidx.compose.material3.Button); polite live regions for announcements
summary: The surface for a live, two-way spoken conversation with an AI assistant: a calm central visual, always-visible state text, live captions, and explicit Mute, Interrupt, Captions and End controls.
whenToUse: While the person talks with the assistant by voice, in a full-screen dialog (Md) or inside an assistant panel (Compact).
whenNotToUse: To dictate text into a prompt use MonarchAiVoiceInput. For a call between people use the call components.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiVoiceMode(state: MonarchAiVoiceModeState, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, level: Float = 0f, agent: MonarchAiAgentRef? = null, agentAvatar: Painter? = null, captions: List<MonarchAiConversationMessage> = emptyList(), captionsVisible: Boolean? = null, muted: Boolean? = null, elapsedSeconds: Int? = null, error: String? = null, size: MonarchAiVoiceModeSize = MonarchAiVoiceModeSize.Md, labels: MonarchAiVoiceModeLabels = MonarchAiVoiceModeLabels(), onCaptionsVisibleChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onMuteChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onInterrupt: (() -> Unit)? = null, onEnd: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRestart: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchAiVoiceModeState { Connecting, Listening, Thinking, Speaking, Muted, Reconnecting, Ended, Error }

class MonarchAiVoiceModeLabels(label: ((agentName: String) -> String)? = null, assistant: String? = null, you: String? = null, states: Map<MonarchAiVoiceModeState, String> = emptyMap(), microphoneMuted: String? = null, mute: String? = null, interrupt: String? = null, captions: String? = null, captionsLabel: String? = null, end: String? = null, restart: String? = null, retry: String? = null, captionsEmpty: String? = null, elapsed: String? = null, lasted: ((duration: String) -> String)? = null, errorFallback: String? = null)

options.name: state
options.description: Where the call is, reported by the app.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the surface. It fills the available width.

options.name: level
options.description: The live audio level, 0 to 1, of whoever is talking. Drives the halo and the bars while listening or speaking, not when animations are off.

options.name: agent
options.description: The assistant; its name labels the surface and its captions.

options.name: agentAvatar
options.description: The assistant's picture, loaded by the app, shown beside its name and hidden from TalkBack.

options.name: captions
options.description: The conversation's messages, oldest first. User and assistant text is shown; a message with streaming text is an interim caption.

options.name: captionsVisible
options.description: Whether captions show. null lets the surface keep its own value, on at first.

options.name: muted
options.description: Whether the microphone is muted. By default only in the Muted state.

options.name: elapsedSeconds
options.description: How long the call has run, shown as a clock while live and as the duration once ended.

options.name: error
options.description: What went wrong, shown on the Error state. A general sentence by default.

options.name: size
options.description: Md stands on its own on the canvas background; Compact is a bordered card with small buttons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the state texts.

options.name: onCaptionsVisibleChange
options.description: Called with the wanted value when the person turns captions on or off.

options.name: onMuteChange
options.description: Called with the wanted value from Mute or the Space key. Shows Mute while the call is live.

options.name: onInterrupt
options.description: Shows Interrupt while the assistant thinks or speaks.

options.name: onEnd
options.description: Shows End while the call is live. Only this button ends the call.

options.name: onRestart
options.description: Shows Start again on the Ended state.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Retry on the Error state.

states.name: connecting, thinking, reconnecting
states.description: The orb shows three dots that rise in turn; the state text says which.

states.name: listening, speaking
states.description: The orb shows five bars and the halo grows with the level.

states.name: muted
states.description: A neutral orb with a resting line; Mute is on. Muted in another state adds the note Your microphone is muted.

states.name: ended
states.description: A neutral orb, Conversation ended, the duration, and Start again when onRestart is given.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger orb with an exclamation mark, the error text, and Retry when onRetry is given.

appearance: Md fills the width on the canvas background; Compact is a surface card with the subtle border and the container radius. The halo uses the assistant subtle role and the orb the assistant solid role with assistant on-solid marks; an error uses the danger roles, muted and ended the subtle and emphasis backgrounds with muted text marks. The state is heading text (body strong when compact), the name and clock label text, captions body text with the speaker in semibold (strong assistant for the assistant, muted for the person). The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Android, like iOS, ships only the surface; the web also ships browser and realtime session helpers. The app owns audio focus, the audio mode, routes and interruptions as the KDoc describes (requestAudioFocus with USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION, ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY), where iOS describes AVAudioSession. Show the Md size in a full-screen Dialog. Captions use the shared MonarchAiConversationMessage model, as on iOS. Space toggles mute as on the web; Android has no Magic Tap. The agent picture is a Painter (agentAvatar), because Monarch for Android loads no images; the web shows an AiAgentAvatar. Monarch bundles no icons, so the controls are text buttons without the web's glyphs, and the muted orb shows a resting line instead of a crossed-out microphone; the state text always says Muted. captionsVisible is hoisted with onCaptionsVisibleChange, or kept by the surface when null (iOS takes an optional Binding). The captions log keeps the newest caption in view unless the person scrolled up, as on the web.
accessibility: The surface is a TalkBack traversal group named "Voice conversation with" and the assistant's name.
The state is always written; each change is announced through a polite live region, except the first state and changes into listening or speaking. An error is announced with its text.

Final captions are announced once each, through a second polite live region, as "You:" or the assistant's name followed by the words; interim captions are hidden from TalkBack until they are final. Captions that are final on appearance or while captions are hidden are not announced.
Mute and Captions are buttons that also report an on or off toggle state.
When Interrupt goes away while it has focus, focus moves to Mute.
The visual is decorative and hidden; it holds still when animations are off. The state text carries the meaning, not color.
Buttons keep 48dp touch targets; text wraps at large font sizes and the captions log scrolls, growing with the font size.
edgeCases: System and tool messages, and messages with no text, are not captions.
Captions show while the call is live even when there are none yet (with a hint), and after it only when there are some.
A level outside 0 to 1 is limited; not a number is 0.
Times of an hour or more show hours: 1:02:09; a negative time is 0:00.
muted is ignored once the call has ended or failed.

examples.title: Listening, with captions
examples.template:
MonarchAiVoiceMode(
    state = MonarchAiVoiceModeState.{{state|pascal}},
    level = {{level|double}}f,
    agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = {{agent.name}}),
    captions = listOf(
        MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = {{captions.0.id}},
            role = MonarchAiRole.{{captions.0.speaker|pascal}},
            parts = listOf(MonarchAiTextPart({{captions.0.text}}, MonarchAiPartState.{{captions.0.state|pascal}})),
            createdAt = "2026-03-10T12:00:00.000Z",
        ),
        MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = {{captions.1.id}},
            role = MonarchAiRole.{{captions.1.speaker|pascal}},
            parts = listOf(MonarchAiTextPart({{captions.1.text}}, MonarchAiPartState.{{captions.1.state|pascal}})),
            createdAt = "2026-03-10T12:00:00.000Z",
        ),
        MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = {{captions.2.id}},
            role = MonarchAiRole.{{captions.2.speaker|pascal}},
            parts = listOf(MonarchAiTextPart({{captions.2.text}}, MonarchAiPartState.{{captions.2.state|pascal}})),
            createdAt = "2026-03-10T12:00:00.000Z",
        ),
    ),
    elapsedSeconds = {{elapsedSeconds}},
    onMuteChange = {},
    onInterrupt = {},
    onEnd = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchAiVoiceMode(
    state = MonarchAiVoiceModeState.Listening,
    level = 0.6f,
    agent = MonarchAiAgentRef(name = "Atlas"),
    captions = listOf(
        MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = "c1",
            role = MonarchAiRole.User,
            parts = listOf(MonarchAiTextPart("What is on my calendar this afternoon?", MonarchAiPartState.Done)),
            createdAt = "2026-03-10T12:00:00.000Z",
        ),
        MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = "c2",
            role = MonarchAiRole.Assistant,
            parts = listOf(MonarchAiTextPart("You have two meetings: the design review at two, and a planning call at four.", MonarchAiPartState.Done)),
            createdAt = "2026-03-10T12:00:00.000Z",
        ),
        MonarchAiConversationMessage(
            id = "c3",
            role = MonarchAiRole.User,
            parts = listOf(MonarchAiTextPart("Move the planning call to", MonarchAiPartState.Streaming)),
            createdAt = "2026-03-10T12:00:00.000Z",
        ),
    ),
    elapsedSeconds = 42,
    onMuteChange = {},
    onInterrupt = {},
    onEnd = {},
)

examples.title: Compact, after the call
examples.code:
MonarchAiVoiceMode(
    state = MonarchAiVoiceModeState.Ended,
    elapsedSeconds = 245,
    size = MonarchAiVoiceModeSize.Compact,
    onRestart = {},
)
